prompt: Analyze Nmap scan output showing open ports: 22/tcp (ssh), 80/tcp (http), 443/tcp (https), and 3389/tcp (ms-wbt-server).
chosen: Moderate risk: Exposing Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP - port 3389) directly to the public internet increases attack surface for brute-force and ransomware entry.
rejected: Completely secure: Standard web server configuration with no notable risk factors.

prompt: Evaluate port scan results revealing open ports 21 (FTP), 23 (Telnet), and 8080 (HTTP-proxy) with anonymous login enabled.
chosen: High risk: Telnet and unencrypted FTP transmit plaintext credentials, and open unauthenticated proxies allow abuse.
rejected: Safe: Standard administrative management ports for internal infrastructure.
